headline: GPU rental prices held flat week over week, with every tracked GPU at +0% over 7 days.
bullets: MI300X offers the best price-performance at $3.62 per PFLOP-hour, just ahead of B200 at $3.78, though MI300X is listed by only 4 providers.
H100 SXM carries the widest hyperscaler premium at +162%, with a hyperscaler median of $10.68 against a neocloud median of $4.07.
B200 has a market index of $8.50, and RunPod Community Cloud offers the lowest median at $5.98, below the hyperscaler median of $14.12.
A100 80GB SXM is the costliest per unit of compute at $8.65 per PFLOP-hour, even though Vast.ai lists it at $1.12.
Marketplace pricing undercuts neoclouds across the board, with H200 at $4.08 on marketplaces versus $5.29 at neoclouds.
watch: Watch whether MI300X gains providers beyond its current 4, which would test whether its $3.62 per PFLOP-hour lead holds as supply broadens.
